source_window.dataset: Buildings of local importance / Local List gateway

first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry bound to an individual Exeter Local List building with explicit building identity/type-use evidence. The selected Exeter City Council Buildings of local importance public page confirms the Local List and the criteria used to identify locally important buildings, including distinctive building types and styles, but the retrieved public HTML window does not expose an individual record with polygon coordinates or downloadable record geometry; source-area information was inspected without parcel-progress credit and no individual building record was accepted.
